items.title: 61531_Juan Tizol oral history interview
items.q: The transcript contains no mention of Juan Tizol or any interaction between Juan Tizol and Count Basie. The text only mentions Basie in the context of the interviewer's memory of Duke Ellington's death.

ctx.x: Yeah. He said, 'Oh, he was so sick.'

I saw him ... the night that Duke died. Basie was playing at the Palladium, and I handled the publicity for the job, and Louie came to see Basie, and he told me then, that he had been to New York to see Duke, and we were talking about Duke, and that was the night that he died.
